title: Market and MVP
description: Size the market from the bottom up, position yourself against what customers do today, and design the smallest experiment that tests your riskiest remaining assumption.
objectives: Build a bottom-up TAM, SAM and SOM with a source or estimate label for every input
Choose a beachhead market and explain why you can dominate it first
Map every competitive alternative, including doing nothing, from your interview evidence
State your 10x dimension and your company's secret in one or two sentences each
Write a positioning statement using Geoffrey Moore's template
Write an MVP experiment plan with a hypothesis, metric, success line and time box
resources: Bill Gurley, How to Miss By a Mile — https://abovethecrowd.com/2014/07/11/how-to-miss-by-a-mile-an-alternative-look-at-ubers-potential-market-size/
Peter Thiel, Competition is for Losers (YC Startup Library) — https://www.ycombinator.com/library/dT-how-to-start-a-startup-competition-is-for-losers
Michael Seibel, How to Plan an MVP (YC Startup Library) — https://www.ycombinator.com/library/6f-how-to-plan-an-mvp
Eric Ries, Minimum Viable Product: a guide — https://www.startuplessonslearned.com/2009/08/minimum-viable-product-guide.html
Steve Blank, AI Killed the MVP. Long Live the IUP — https://steveblank.com/2026/09/25/ai-killed-the-mvp-long-live-the-iup/

es.title: Mercado y MVP
es.description: Dimensiona el mercado de abajo hacia arriba, posiciónate frente a lo que los clientes hacen hoy y diseña el experimento más pequeño que ponga a prueba tu supuesto pendiente más riesgoso.
objectives: Construir un TAM, SAM y SOM de abajo hacia arriba con una fuente o una etiqueta de estimación para cada dato
Elegir un mercado cabeza de playa y explicar por qué puedes dominarlo primero
Mapear todas las alternativas competidoras, incluida la de no hacer nada, a partir de la evidencia de tus entrevistas
Expresar tu dimensión 10x y el secreto de tu empresa en una o dos oraciones cada uno
Escribir una declaración de posicionamiento con la plantilla de Geoffrey Moore
Escribir un plan de experimento de MVP con hipótesis, métrica, criterio de éxito y plazo
resources: Bill Gurley, cómo errar por mucho al estimar el mercado de Uber — https://abovethecrowd.com/2014/07/11/how-to-miss-by-a-mile-an-alternative-look-at-ubers-potential-market-size/
Peter Thiel, la competencia es para perdedores (YC Startup Library) — https://www.ycombinator.com/library/dT-how-to-start-a-startup-competition-is-for-losers
April Dunford, Obviously Awesome (sitio del libro) — https://www.aprildunford.com/books
Michael Seibel, cómo planear un MVP (YC Startup Library) — https://www.ycombinator.com/library/6f-how-to-plan-an-mvp
Eric Ries, guía del producto mínimo viable — https://www.startuplessonslearned.com/2009/08/minimum-viable-product-guide.html
Steve Blank, la IA mató al MVP: larga vida al IUP — https://steveblank.com/2026/09/25/ai-killed-the-mvp-long-live-the-iup/
